currentOutcomePath.barSelection: bars with date > scanDate, sorted ascending, then first 1/3/5/10/20 available bars
currentOutcomePath.currentHistorySemantics: V8.12 fetchHistoricalDaily explicitly requests adjusted=false raw daily candles.

asymmetry.formalSelection: V8.12 requires historyFreshness.usable===true before buildMarketFeatures reaches Formal selection.
asymmetry.researchOutcome: R02/counterfactual reader bypasses that admission receipt and reads raw history_json directly.
asymmetry.conclusion: Selection-time history is provenance-gated, but generic future outcome bars are not equivalently provenance-gated.

ambiguity: If T1 was a verified symbol suspension/no-trade day, T2 may be the first valid symbol session.
If T1 was a stale/missing cache bar while the symbol traded, T2 is not valid D1.
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.result: Identical cached bars produce different horizon semantics depending on missing-bar provenance, which current R02 does not read.

fixedSyntheticWitnesses.corporateAction: 2-for-1 split between scan and next observed bar
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.economicInterpretation: Near-flat pre/post split value before ordinary market movement; raw price ratio is not comparable.
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.result: Corporate-action continuity must be validated before D1/D3/D5 return/MFE/MAE.

cashDistributionPolicy.note: Cash dividend ex-date is not the same as split/capital-reduction discontinuity. Research must preregister whether the outcome is raw price return or shareholder total return; do not silently mix.

preferredReuse.symbolSessionOwner: Existing Corporate Action / symbol-session quality semantics and V8.12 history-source revalidation.
preferredReuse.corporateActionOwner: Existing Corporate Actions lane; do not create a second adjustment taxonomy in R02.
preferredReuse.priceVolumeOwner: Existing PV quality-overlay pattern for later-discovered source/event defects.
preferredReuse.rule: R02 consumes versioned quality receipts; it does not independently infer suspensions or corporate actions from price shapes.

R02Guard: Only rows with horizon-specific VALID outcome quality enter promotion-grade Selection Alpha.
Do not use next-available-bar slicing when an intervening expected symbol session is unexplained.
MFE/MAE require the same continuity quality as endpoint return.
Breakout HELD_3D/FAILED_CLOSE_WITHIN_3D requires verified first three expected symbol sessions; unknown gaps => outcome UNKNOWN.
Coverage must report excluded/unknown counts by reason and cohort/pool/date.
Historical rows may be descriptive only when exact gap/corporate-action provenance is unavailable.
